title: Dr. Agho Emmanuel Ogo-Ochi is a distinguished playwright, theatre director, and youth administrator from Benue State, Nigeria. He holds multiple degrees in Drama and Theatre Arts, and has received national recognition for his plays, including 'Sown to the Winds' and 'Desire of the Hawk.' With a strong background in youth development, he has contributed significantly to the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) in various administrative roles, earning accolades for his innovative programs aimed at empowering Nigerian youth. He is also a visiting lecturer at Gombe State University, where he has initiated projects to enhance educational development. Dr. Ogo-Ochi is married and has children, and his work has positively impacted the lives of many in his community.
